articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Huntington Bancshares Reshapes Wealth Business And Board As Valuation Lags. Huntington Bancshares (NasdaqGS:HBAN) is outsourcing its US$28b wealth management business to Ameriprise. The bank is also refreshing its board with former Cadence Bank directors following their recent merger. For you as an investor, this marks a clear shift in how Huntington Bancshares approaches higher touch wealth services versus its core banking operations.
